title: Mozilla try now better browser loss

change.control: Existing Firefox product page, the publisher’s control recipe A.
change.variant: Use the pictured It’s Time You Tried A Better Browser headline treatment with a “Try Now!” download button; associated subhead: Your online security is our top priority. Firefox includes easy ways to tell the good guys from the bad..

significance.reported: Publisher explicitly reports all four pictured Try Now recipes statistically significantly worse than control.

quote: The four recipes shown below all performed significantly worse than our existing page in a statistically significant way.
notes: One of four distinct pictured losing recipes in a 16-arm multivariate test on Internet Explorer visitors. Headline and associated subhead treatment changed together with the button. The raw result table has recipe letters but screenshots do not map letters to headline treatments, so no per-recipe number or sample is assigned. The pictured variant is identified by its headline, not an invented recipe mapping. Business type reflects the nonprofit-owned browser organization; the conversion is a browser download, not a SaaS subscription.
